title: Female Yakuza Tale: Inquisition and Torture
writer: Tarô Bonten, Masahiro Kakefuda, Ikuo Sekimoto
actors: Reiko Ike, Makoto Aikawa, Arumi Kuri
plot: Gambling swordswoman Ochô allies with a gang of prostitutes forced by a Yakuza clan - whose boss has kidnapped the daughter of its previous lord - into smuggling drugs in their vaginas.
